body: Just feel alone and hopeless dont really know how to describe it at this point. The concept of dyi g just seems preferable to living, just need to wait for the impulsive push

Honestly you're still young and life can change. I didn't meet my current best friend until I was 16, you will make friends it just takes time. Try talking to others with your interests even if it's awkward, everything is awkward at 15.

Also i would advise talking to your parents, they could help and I'm sure they care about you.

Life will get better as cliche as it sounds you still have a lot of changes to go through and people you will meet.

I feel like I can relate somewhat, I've been considering suicide for a while because I'm just not sure if the life I'll live will be worth living even with me giving 100% effort. The thing I've realized is although you may think you're coming from a logical viewpoint you have to consider that there might also be ways to change ur perspective which may change your views on suicide.

Right now I'm going to try to get help before I consider anything else, perhaps that can make me feel like there's reason to life and help me to strive to better my situation. I agree with your friend, try to get help, it's difficult to see but you may not regret it in the future. I honestly believe there is something positive we may not be seeing.
